full_prompt_en: A square hyperreal close-up focuses on a single blue-green eye and the surrounding freckled skin, with the tip of a paintbrush entering from the lower right. The eye fills the upper middle of the frame, framed by a reddish eyelid and a dense fringe of dark lashes. Fine radial streaks of blue, teal, and gold ring the dark pupil, while a bright irregular reflection sits on the glossy cornea. The white of the eye is slightly pink near the inner and outer edges rather than uniformly white. Above it, a thick brow and warm auburn hair press close to the top border. Below, pale skin is covered with tiny freckles, pores, fine hairs, and gentle red patches that remain individually visible. The small brush tip points diagonally upward toward the lower iris, its yellow-tan bristles standing apart from the much smoother wet shine of the eye. A blurred silver ferrule and dark handle lead out toward the bottom edge. The right edge is partly lost behind a soft close foreground shape, keeping attention on the eye and brush contact. No broader face or setting is shown; the image is cropped so tightly that surface detail becomes the scene. Strong but soft light comes from the upper left, lighting the iris and skin texture and creating the crisp eye reflection, while the folds above and below fall into reddish shadow. Sharp focus holds on the central eye and nearest skin; the brush handle and outer edges soften with shallow depth of field. The overall composition turns a very small action into an intense study of reflective color, living texture, and precise proximity.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形超写实近景聚焦于一只蓝绿色眼睛和周围长有雀斑的皮肤，一支画笔笔尖从右下进入。眼睛填满画面上方中央，由微红眼睑和浓密深睫毛围住。蓝、青绿和金色的细放射纹环绕深色瞳孔，湿亮角膜上有一块明亮不规则倒影。眼白在内外眼角略带粉色，并非均一纯白。其上，厚眉和暖红棕头发贴近顶边。下方浅色皮肤满是微小雀斑、毛孔、细汗毛与柔和红斑，每处仍可分辨。小画笔尖斜向上指着虹膜下缘，黄褐色刷毛与眼睛更平滑的湿亮表面分开。模糊的银色笔箍和深色笔杆通向底边。右边缘部分消失在柔化的近前景形体后，使注意力留在眼睛和笔触附近。画中没有更完整的脸或场所；裁切紧到表面细节本身成为场景。较强但柔和的光从左上进入，照亮虹膜与皮肤纹理，形成清晰的眼部反光，上下褶处则落入微红阴影。清晰焦点停在中央眼睛与最近的皮肤上，笔杆和外围随浅景深柔化。整体构图把极小动作变成对反光色彩、鲜活肌理和精准距离的强烈研究。
style_prompt_en: The image has hyperreal photographic or painted precision at very close range. Tiny surface pores, fine fibers, wet highlights, and minute color shifts remain distinct in the focal zone, while outer areas fall gradually into shallow-focus blur. Warm reddish tones meet saturated blue-green, gold, and deep black accents. Soft directional light reveals texture without flattening it and produces a crisp specular reflection on the smoothest surface. The composition crops tightly around one luminous detail, so scale and proximity carry the drama. Rich microtexture contrasts with controlled blur, giving the image an almost tactile immediacy.
style_prompt_zh: 图像在极近距离呈现超写实的摄影或绘画精度。微小表面孔隙、细密纤维、湿亮高光与细微色变在焦点区域仍各自清楚，外围则逐渐落入浅景深模糊。暖红色调与饱和蓝绿、金色和深黑重音相遇。柔和定向光揭示肌理而不将其压平，并在最光滑的表面制造清晰镜面反光。构图紧紧裁住一个发亮细节，让尺度与距离承担戏剧性。丰富微观纹理与受控模糊相对，使画面具有几乎可触的即时感。
theme_en: A close study of a blue-green eye with a brush tip near the iris
theme_zh: 一只蓝绿色眼睛的特写，画笔尖靠近虹膜
name: Hyperrealism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
